research.title: Covariance Shrinkage Under Uneven Feature Missingness
bullets: Formulated how uneven feature observation rates affect covariance estimation, and led development of a shrinkage estimator using pairwise observation counts.
Evaluated estimation error and downstream discriminant classification on simulated missingness patterns, comparing the estimator with mean imputation and uniform shrinkage baselines.

research.title: Regularized Class-Prior Estimation Under Label Shift
bullets: Investigated instability in label-shift correction with overlapping class distributions, and led development of a regularized class-prior estimator using held-out confusion matrices.
Compared corrected probability estimates across simulated class-prior shifts, examining calibration, prior estimation error, and sensitivity to validation sample composition.

research.title: Stable Importance Weighting for Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated the tradeoff between importance-weight instability and predictive coverage under covariate shift, and led development of an effective-sample-size-guided weight clipping procedure.

Designed evaluations varying distribution overlap and density-ratio misspecification, comparing marginal coverage, subgroup coverage, and interval width against unclipped weighted conformal prediction.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sparse Linear Regression
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso and elastic net regression, checking objective convergence against reference implementations on synthetic correlated-feature datasets.
Compared prediction error and feature-selection stability across regularization settings, using nested cross-validation to separate parameter tuning from final evaluation.

projects.title: Approximate Kernel Methods for Nonlinear Classification
bullets: Implemented random Fourier features and Nyström approximations for kernel classification, using shared preprocessing and training splits for consistent comparisons.
Evaluated predictive performance, runtime, and memory requirements across approximation sizes, examining sensitivity to kernel bandwidth and landmark selection.

projects.title: Probability Calibration for Supervised Classifiers
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling and isotonic calibration for classifier probabilities, reserving separate data partitions for model fitting, calibration, and evaluation.
Compared log loss, Brier score, and reliability diagrams across calibration methods, examining how calibration-set size affected probability estimates.

projects.title: Bootstrap Intervals for Regression Predictions
bullets: Implemented residual and pairs bootstrap procedures for linear regression predictions, constructing simulation settings with constant and input-dependent noise variance.
Compared empirical interval coverage and width across resampling procedures, documenting failure patterns under heteroscedasticity and misspecified linear mean functions.
